curation.notes: Imported from validation panel. Original serotype: Paratyphi B. Panel notes: The SNP in gene STM3356 that is associated with the d-Tartrate nonfermenting phenotype characteristic of the typhoidal pathotype was not detected.

reads.download_cmd: fasterq-dump --gzip --outdir data/ SRR1584383 && mv data/SRR1584383_1.fastq.gz data/reads_1.fq.gz && mv data/SRR1584383_2.fastq.gz data/reads_2.fq.gz

SeqSero2.run_cmd: SeqSero2_package.py -m a -t 4 -i data/reads_1.fq.gz data/reads_2.fq.gz -d actual/seqsero2/ -n seqsero2

SeqSero2S.run_cmd: SeqSero2S_package.py -m a -t 4 -i data/reads_1.fq.gz data/reads_2.fq.gz -d actual/seqsero2s/ -n seqsero2s

validation_instructions.serological: Expected serotype: Paratyphi B. Antigenic formula should match 4:b:1,2. Note: d-Tartrate fermentation status differentiates typhoidal pathotype.
validation_instructions.mlst: Expected ST1577. Accept exact match. Flag novel alleles for manual review.

notes: Part of FDA-CFSAN validation panel. The SNP in gene STM3356 that is associated with the d-Tartrate nonfermenting phenotype characteristic of the typhoidal pathotype was not detected.
